title.narrative: National Programme for Tuberculosis Control and Chest Disease

description.narrative: Sri Lanka - Tuberculosis - Ministry of Health of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka - MOH. This program has the following goals: Achieve universal access to TB diagnosis and treatment by 2025 and to get on track to achieve the End TB targets by 2035. The objectives of this program are: To find and successfully treat, on average, between 2021 and 2025, 10,000 cases of drug sensitive TB annually, including 600 children. To successfully treat, on average, each year between 2021 and 2025, 11,600 eligible cases for TB preventive treatment (TPT). To properly engage the private sector in TB diagnosis and care, and ensure by end 2025, 30% of all cases notified are referred from the private sector. To strengthen monitoring and evaluation of TB control activities at all levels. To significantly increase the quality and quantity of operational research studies on TB. To significantly improve the organisation and management and control of TB activities
